```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(ggplot2)
})
set.seed(42)
graphics.off()
```

# Questions

1. Is the excess of leading-edge gene mutations in cluster 3 real, or does it depend on a few low-VAF calls
   (check at VAF >= 3%, >= 5% and without indels)?
2. Is it specific to this gene set, or would a random gene set with the same mutation frequencies show the same?
   (matched random gene sets; also total WES mutation burden by cluster)
3. Is a mutated gene expressed higher in the tumor that carries the mutation (same gene, same tumor), also after
   accounting for cluster?
4. Is the 16-gene expression score higher in tumors with a leading-edge mutation, after accounting for cluster?

All tests are exploratory (few mutated tumors).

```{r paths_and_parameters}
leading_edge_genes <- c("CRYAB", "FGF10", "SOCS2", "GPX4", "MAP1B", "DUSP1", "STAT3", "MBD4",
                        "NCOA3", "ENO2", "ESR2", "SFRP1", "FOXA1", "CASP8", "ITGA2", "MMP2")

vst_file     <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/NMF/vst_transformed_data.csv"
cluster_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/NMF/GenePattern_NMFConsensus/vst_transformed_data.consensus.k.3.gct"
wes_audit    <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WES/Downstream/PCGR/Compare_TumorOnly_vs_WithPON/maftools/Tier_1_common/Combined_MAF/Full_MAF_nonsilent_variant_PCGR_VAF_match_audit_2026-09-23.tsv"

out_dir <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/Downstream/Chromatin_Estrogen_pathway_scores/plots/mutation_vs_expression"
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Scenarios for the mutation calls
scenarios <- list(
  `VAF >= 3%`            = list(thr = 0.03, drop_indels = FALSE),
  `VAF >= 5%`            = list(thr = 0.05, drop_indels = FALSE),
  `VAF >= 3%, no indels` = list(thr = 0.03, drop_indels = TRUE)
)
N_PERM <- 5000
# Scenarios drawn in Fig 1 (the no-indel scenario gives the same tumor counts at 3%, so it is left out of the main figure)
FIG1_SCENARIOS <- c("VAF >= 3%", "VAF >= 5%")

nonsilent_classes <- c(
  "Missense_Mutation", "Nonsense_Mutation", "Nonstop_Mutation",
  "Frame_Shift_Del", "Frame_Shift_Ins", "In_Frame_Del", "In_Frame_Ins",
  "Splice_Site", "Splice_Region", "Translation_Start_Site"
)
indel_classes <- c("Frame_Shift_Del", "Frame_Shift_Ins", "In_Frame_Del", "In_Frame_Ins")
cluster_cols <- c("Cluster 1" = "#1B9E77", "Cluster 2" = "#D95F02", "Cluster 3" = "#7570B3")

stopifnot(file.exists(vst_file), file.exists(cluster_file), file.exists(wes_audit))
```

```{r helpers}
std_id <- function(x) {
  x <- toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
  x <- sub("^X(?=TP)", "", x, perl = TRUE)
  x <- sub("_S[0-9]+$", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\.", "-", x)
  x <- sub("^JC287-", "", x)
  x <- sub("(_T|-T)$", "", x)
  x <- sub("(?<=[0-9])T$", "", x, perl = TRUE)
  sub("-0+(?=[0-9])", "-", x, perl = TRUE)      # TP09-09 = TP09-9
}
save_plot <- function(file_base, width, height, draw_fn, res = 300) {
  pdf(paste0(file_base, ".pdf"), width = width, height = height); draw_fn(); dev.off()
  png(paste0(file_base, ".png"), width = width, height = height, units = "in", res = res); draw_fn(); dev.off()
  cat("Saved:", paste0(file_base, c(".pdf", ".png")), sep = "\n  "); cat("\n")
}
p_txt <- function(p) ifelse(is.na(p), "NA", ifelse(p < 0.001, "P < 0.001", paste0("P = ", sprintf("%.3f", p))))   # vectorised
theme_nat <- function() theme_classic(base_size = 8, base_family = "Helvetica") +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(), strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 8),
        axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.35), axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.35),
        plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 6, colour = "grey30"),
        legend.key.size = unit(3, "mm"))
```

```{r read_data}
# ---- expression (VST), genes x tumors ----
x <- fread(vst_file)
sample_like <- function(v) mean(grepl("^X?TP[0-9]+[.-]", toupper(as.character(v)))) > 0.5
if (sample_like(names(x)[-1])) {
  mat <- as.matrix(x[, -1]); rownames(mat) <- as.character(x[[1]])
} else if (sample_like(x[[1]])) {
  smp <- as.character(x[[1]]); mat <- t(as.matrix(x[, -1])); colnames(mat) <- smp
} else stop("Could not tell which axis holds the tumors; check the VST file layout.")
storage.mode(mat) <- "numeric"
ids <- sub("\\..*$", "", rownames(mat))
if (mean(grepl("^ENSG", ids)) > 0.5) {
  if (!requireNamespace("org.Hs.eg.db", quietly = TRUE)) stop("Ensembl IDs need org.Hs.eg.db.")
  sym <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db::org.Hs.eg.db, keys = ids, column = "SYMBOL", keytype = "ENSEMBL", multiVals = "first")
  rownames(mat) <- ifelse(is.na(sym), ids, sym)
} else rownames(mat) <- toupper(rownames(mat))
d <- as.data.table(mat, keep.rownames = "Gene")
d <- d[, lapply(.SD, mean, na.rm = TRUE), by = Gene]
mat <- as.matrix(d[, -1]); rownames(mat) <- d$Gene
colnames(mat) <- std_id(colnames(mat))

# ---- clusters ----
cl <- fread(cluster_file, skip = 2)
cl_col <- grep("membership", names(cl), value = TRUE)[1]
cl <- cl[, .(Tumor = std_id(Name), Cluster = paste("Cluster", get(cl_col)))]

# ---- WES calls (all genes) ----
wes <- fread(wes_audit, sep = "\t", na.strings = c("", "NA", "."),
             select = c("Hugo_Symbol", "Tumor_Sample_Barcode", "Variant_Classification", "VAF_TUMOR_fraction"))
wes[, Tumor := std_id(Tumor_Sample_Barcode)]
wes_tumors <- unique(wes$Tumor)
calls_all <- wes[Variant_Classification %in% nonsilent_classes & !is.na(VAF_TUMOR_fraction),
                 .(Tumor, Gene = toupper(Hugo_Symbol), Class = Variant_Classification, VAF = VAF_TUMOR_fraction)]
rm(wes)

# tumors used: WES + RNA cluster + expression
tt <- Reduce(intersect, list(wes_tumors, cl$Tumor, colnames(mat)))
tumor_cl <- cl[match(tt, Tumor), Cluster]
cat("Tumors with WES and RNA-seq:", length(tt), "\n"); print(table(tumor_cl))
le <- intersect(leading_edge_genes, rownames(mat))
cat("Leading-edge genes found in the VST matrix:", length(le), "of", length(leading_edge_genes), "\n")

# z-scores of the leading-edge genes across tumors with RNA-seq and the mean-z score
z <- t(scale(t(mat[le, tt, drop = FALSE])))
sig <- colMeans(z, na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r per_scenario}
res_tests <- list(); res_perm <- list(); res_pairs <- list(); res_pct <- list(); null_list <- list(); tumor_tabs <- list()

for (sc in names(scenarios)) {
  s <- scenarios[[sc]]
  calls <- calls_all[VAF >= s$thr]
  if (s$drop_indels) calls <- calls[!(Class %in% indel_classes)]
  calls <- calls[Tumor %in% tt]

  # ---- tumor-level: >= 1 leading-edge mutation ----
  le_calls <- calls[Gene %in% leading_edge_genes]
  n_genes <- setNames(rep(0L, length(tt)), tt)
  ng <- le_calls[, .(n = uniqueN(Gene)), by = Tumor]
  n_genes[ng$Tumor] <- ng$n
  any_mut <- n_genes > 0
  c3 <- tumor_cl == "Cluster 3"

  pct <- data.table(Scenario = sc, Cluster = c("Cluster 1", "Cluster 2", "Cluster 3"))
  pct[, `:=`(N = sapply(Cluster, function(k) sum(tumor_cl == k)),
             Mutated = sapply(Cluster, function(k) sum(any_mut[tumor_cl == k])))]
  res_pct[[sc]] <- pct

  fp <- fisher.test(matrix(c(sum(any_mut[c3]), sum(!any_mut[c3]), sum(any_mut[!c3]), sum(!any_mut[!c3])), nrow = 2))$p.value
  obs <- mean(any_mut[c3]) - mean(any_mut[!c3])

  # ---- matched random gene sets (same mutation frequency per gene) ----
  cnt <- calls[, .(n = uniqueN(Tumor)), by = Gene]
  universe <- union(rownames(mat), cnt$Gene)
  n_u <- setNames(rep(0L, length(universe)), universe); n_u[cnt$Gene] <- cnt$n
  mut_genes <- names(n_u)[n_u > 0 & !(names(n_u) %in% leading_edge_genes)]
  M <- matrix(FALSE, nrow = length(tt), ncol = length(mut_genes), dimnames = list(tt, mut_genes))
  cm <- calls[Gene %in% mut_genes]
  M[cbind(cm$Tumor, cm$Gene)] <- TRUE
  n_le <- sapply(leading_edge_genes, function(g) if (g %in% names(n_u)) n_u[[g]] else 0L)
  cand <- lapply(n_le, function(k) if (k == 0) NULL else which(abs(n_u[mut_genes] - k) <= 1))
  null_stat <- replicate(N_PERM, {
    pick <- unlist(lapply(cand, function(cx) if (is.null(cx) || !length(cx)) NULL else cx[sample.int(length(cx), 1)]))
    a <- if (length(pick)) rowSums(M[, pick, drop = FALSE]) > 0 else rep(FALSE, length(tt))
    mean(a[c3]) - mean(a[!c3])
  })
  perm_p <- (sum(null_stat >= obs) + 1) / (N_PERM + 1)
  null_list[[sc]] <- data.table(Scenario = sc, Null = null_stat, Observed = obs)

  # ---- total WES mutation burden by cluster ----
  burden <- setNames(rep(0L, length(tt)), tt)
  b <- calls[, .N, by = Tumor]; burden[b$Tumor] <- b$N
  kw_burden <- kruskal.test(burden ~ factor(tumor_cl))$p.value

  res_perm[[sc]] <- data.table(Scenario = sc, Observed_diff = obs, Null_mean = mean(null_stat),
                               Empirical_p_one_sided = perm_p, Fisher_p_C3_vs_1_2 = fp,
                               Burden_KW_p = kw_burden,
                               Median_burden_C1 = median(burden[tumor_cl == "Cluster 1"]),
                               Median_burden_C2 = median(burden[tumor_cl == "Cluster 2"]),
                               Median_burden_C3 = median(burden[tumor_cl == "Cluster 3"]))

  # ---- expression of the mutated gene in the mutated tumor ----
  cell <- le_calls[Gene %in% le, .(Class = if (.N > 1) "Multi_Hit" else Class[1], VAF = max(VAF)), by = .(Tumor, Gene)]
  pairs <- cell[Tumor %in% tt]
  pairs[, `:=`(z = z[cbind(Gene, Tumor)],
               pct_rank = mapply(function(g, t) mean(z[g, ] <= z[g, t]), Gene, Tumor),
               Cluster = tumor_cl[match(Tumor, tt)], Scenario = sc)]
  res_pairs[[sc]] <- pairs

  long <- as.data.table(as.table(z)); setnames(long, c("Gene", "Tumor", "z"))
  long[, Cluster := tumor_cl[match(Tumor, tt)]]
  long[, Mutated := paste(Tumor, Gene) %in% paste(pairs$Tumor, pairs$Gene)]
  if (sum(long$Mutated) >= 3) {
    fit <- summary(lm(z ~ Mutated + Cluster + Gene, data = long))$coefficients
    add <- fit["MutatedTRUE", ]
    res_tests[[length(res_tests) + 1]] <- data.table(Scenario = sc, Test = "Mutated gene expression (z) vs not, adjusted for cluster and gene (lm)",
                                                     N = sum(long$Mutated), Estimate = add["Estimate"], P = add["Pr(>|t|)"])
  }
  # ---- 16-gene score vs leading-edge mutation ----
  wt <- wilcox.test(sig[any_mut], sig[!any_mut], exact = FALSE)
  res_tests[[length(res_tests) + 1]] <- data.table(Scenario = sc, Test = "16-gene score: tumors with >=1 mutation vs none (Wilcoxon)",
                                                   N = length(tt), Estimate = median(sig[any_mut]) - median(sig[!any_mut]), P = wt$p.value)
  fit2 <- summary(lm(sig ~ factor(tumor_cl) + any_mut))$coefficients
  res_tests[[length(res_tests) + 1]] <- data.table(Scenario = sc, Test = "16-gene score ~ cluster + any mutation (lm, mutation term)",
                                                   N = length(tt), Estimate = fit2[nrow(fit2), "Estimate"], P = fit2[nrow(fit2), "Pr(>|t|)"])
  sp <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(sig, n_genes, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE))
  res_tests[[length(res_tests) + 1]] <- data.table(Scenario = sc, Test = "16-gene score vs number of mutated leading-edge genes (Spearman rho)",
                                                   N = length(tt), Estimate = unname(sp$estimate), P = sp$p.value)
  res_tests[[length(res_tests) + 1]] <- data.table(Scenario = sc, Test = "Tumors with >=1 mutation: cluster 3 vs clusters 1+2 (Fisher)",
                                                   N = length(tt), Estimate = obs, P = fp)
  tumor_tabs[[sc]] <- data.table(Scenario = sc, Tumor = tt, Cluster = tumor_cl, n_mutated_genes = n_genes,
                                 score_16gene = sig, total_burden = burden)
}

pct_dt <- rbindlist(res_pct)[, Percent := round(100 * Mutated / N, 1)]
perm_dt <- rbindlist(res_perm); tests_dt <- rbindlist(res_tests); pairs_dt <- rbindlist(res_pairs, fill = TRUE)
fwrite(pct_dt, file.path(out_dir, "percent_tumors_mutated_by_cluster.tsv"), sep = "\t")
fwrite(perm_dt, file.path(out_dir, "matched_random_geneset_test.tsv"), sep = "\t")
tests_dt[, P := signif(P, 3)]
fwrite(tests_dt, file.path(out_dir, "mutation_vs_expression_tests.tsv"), sep = "\t")
fwrite(pairs_dt, file.path(out_dir, "mutated_gene_tumor_expression.tsv"), sep = "\t")
fwrite(rbindlist(tumor_tabs), file.path(out_dir, "per_tumor_summary.tsv"), sep = "\t")

cat("\nTumors with >= 1 leading-edge mutation, by cluster:\n"); print(pct_dt)
cat("\nMatched random gene sets and mutation burden:\n"); print(perm_dt)
cat("\nTests:\n"); print(tests_dt)
cat("\nExpression of each mutated gene in its mutated tumor (z across tumors, percentile rank):\n")
print(pairs_dt[Scenario == names(scenarios)[1], .(Tumor, Gene, Class, VAF = round(100 * VAF, 1), Cluster, z = round(z, 2), pct_rank = round(pct_rank, 2))][order(Gene, Tumor)])
```

```{r fig1_percent_mutated}
pct_plot <- pct_dt[Scenario %in% FIG1_SCENARIOS]
pct_plot[, Scenario := factor(Scenario, FIG1_SCENARIOS)]
fisher_lab <- perm_dt[Scenario %in% FIG1_SCENARIOS,
                      .(Scenario = factor(Scenario, FIG1_SCENARIOS),
                        label = paste0("Cluster 3 vs 1+2: Fisher ", p_txt(Fisher_p_C3_vs_1_2)))]
p1 <- ggplot(pct_plot, aes(Cluster, Percent, fill = Cluster)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(Mutated, "/", N)), vjust = -0.4, size = 2.6) +
  geom_text(data = fisher_lab, aes(x = 0.5, y = Inf, label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, vjust = 1.4, size = 2.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_cols, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.2))) +
  facet_wrap(~Scenario) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Tumors with >= 1 leading-edge mutation (%)",
       caption = "WES, non-silent calls in the 16 leading-edge genes. Numbers above bars: mutated tumors / tumors in the cluster.") +
  theme_nat()
save_plot(file.path(out_dir, "Fig1_percent_mutated_by_cluster"), width = 5.2, height = 3.2, draw_fn = function() print(p1))
```

```{r fig3_expression_of_mutated_genes}
sc1 <- names(scenarios)[1]
pr <- copy(pairs_dt[Scenario == sc1])
if (nrow(pr) > 0) {
  mg <- pr[, .N, by = Gene][order(-N, Gene), Gene]
  bg <- as.data.table(as.table(z[mg, , drop = FALSE])); setnames(bg, c("Gene", "Tumor", "z"))
  bg[, `:=`(Gene = factor(Gene, mg), Cluster = tumor_cl[match(Tumor, tt)])]

  # Place mutated points and labels so they never overlap, within each gene:
  # - a point whose z is within 0.12 of the previous one is moved sideways, so both points are visible
  # - labels are kept at least 0.30 z-units apart (pushed upward when needed); a thin line joins label and point
  place <- function(d) {
    d <- d[order(z)]
    zz <- d$z; n <- length(zz)
    dx <- numeric(n); ly <- zz
    for (i in seq_len(n)[-1]) {
      if (zz[i] - zz[i - 1] < 0.12 && dx[i - 1] == 0) dx[i] <- 0.10
      ly[i] <- max(ly[i], ly[i - 1] + 0.30)
    }
    d[, `:=`(dx = dx, ly = ly)]
    d
  }
  pr <- pr[, place(.SD), by = Gene]
  pr[, `:=`(x_pt = match(Gene, mg) + dx)]
  pr[, x_lab := x_pt + 0.16]

  p3 <- ggplot(bg, aes(Gene, z)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.5, colour = "grey50", fill = "grey95", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_point(aes(colour = Cluster), size = 0.9, alpha = 0.7, position = position_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0, seed = 42)) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = cluster_cols, guide = "none") +
    geom_segment(data = pr, aes(x = x_pt, xend = x_lab - 0.02, y = z, yend = ly), inherit.aes = FALSE,
                 colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.25) +
    geom_point(data = pr, aes(x = x_pt, y = z, fill = Cluster), inherit.aes = FALSE, shape = 21, size = 2.8,
               colour = "black", stroke = 0.4) +
    geom_text(data = pr, aes(x = x_lab, y = ly, label = Tumor), inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, size = 2.1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_cols, name = "Mutated tumor (cluster)") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Gene expression (z-score across tumors)",
         title = paste0("Expression of each mutated leading-edge gene (", sc1, ")"),
         caption = "Small points: all tumors with RNA-seq, coloured by cluster. Large outlined points: tumors carrying a mutation in that gene.") +
    theme_nat() + theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9))
  save_plot(file.path(out_dir, "Fig3_expression_of_mutated_genes"), width = 7.2, height = 3.8, draw_fn = function() print(p3))
}
```

```{r fig4_score}
st <- rbindlist(tumor_tabs)[Scenario == sc1]
st[, `:=`(Mutation = factor(ifelse(n_mutated_genes > 0, ">= 1 leading-edge mutation", "No mutation"),
                            c(">= 1 leading-edge mutation", "No mutation")))]
lm_p <- tests_dt[Scenario == sc1 & grepl("score ~ cluster", Test), P]
p4 <- ggplot(st, aes(Cluster, score_16gene)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = Cluster), alpha = 0.35, outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.55, colour = "grey25", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = Mutation, shape = Mutation, size = Mutation), position = position_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0, seed = 42)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_cols, guide = "none") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(">= 1 leading-edge mutation" = "#D62728", "No mutation" = "#52606D"), name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(">= 1 leading-edge mutation" = 17, "No mutation" = 16), name = NULL) +
  scale_size_manual(values = c(">= 1 leading-edge mutation" = 2.6, "No mutation" = 1.8), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "16-gene leading-edge score (mean z)",
       title = paste0("Expression score by cluster and mutation (", sc1, ")"),
       caption = paste(strwrap(paste0("Mutation term in a model with cluster: ", p_txt(lm_p),
                                      " (lm). Triangles: tumors with >= 1 WES mutation in the leading-edge genes."), 75), collapse = "\n")) +
  theme_nat() + theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9), legend.position = "bottom")
save_plot(file.path(out_dir, "Fig4_score_by_cluster_and_mutation"), width = 4.2, height = 3.8, draw_fn = function() print(p4))
cat("All outputs are in:", out_dir, "\n")
```
